🧼 EASY TO CLEAN - Large and functional wide mouth opening and smooth rounded shape for easy care.

EXPERIENCED JOB & USA BASED: We are a USA-based company specialized in customized and unique gifts for weddings, couples, housewarmings, colleagues, Christmas, or any other special occasion with personal messages & text. We produce our products that are specially designed for you in our facilities.
